description: Answer 'are we ready to launch?': what still stands before the launch or the next release, grouped by who it waits on (you, the Developer, other people), with serious risks nothing is reducing. It is the same summary as the dashboard's Ready to launch? page, so answer from it. It counts the next open release goal and what it bundles, else the goals marked for launch (update_goal for_launch), else every open goal.
